e: Spot the perfect setup. Click buy. Watch it fly.
es: Every chart is an opportunity. Every day is payday.
r: Waiting three days for a setup that never comes.
rs: Most of the job is sitting on your hands and not clicking anything.

e: Big news drops. You catch the whole move.
r: Spreads widen, price spikes both ways, and your stop gets hit first.
rs: The pros often wait for the dust to settle before they trade the news.

es: One bad trade and you're clearly not cut out for this.
r: Good traders lose all the time. Just small.
rs: A stop loss on every trade, so no single loss can sink the account.

e: Crushing it on demo. Time to go live.
es: Same strategy, same results. How hard can it be?
r: Same setup on a live account, and suddenly your hands are shaking.
rs: Real money changes how you trade. Start small and size up slowly.
